protectedExisting.name: Westlight Theatre / Stadium district
protectedExisting.rule: Preserve the accepted bowl, theatre, members club, center-hung display, four public levels and every verified bidirectional stair route.

protectedExisting.name: Existing Westlight main district and shore threshold

pierBuildingAudit.name: Malt & Lantern brew-barn
pierBuildingAudit.design: Preserve rooms and two floors; expose a pile-and-cap undercroft, add a continuous south waterside deck, fenders, service landing and two shore-side egress doors.

pierBuildingAudit.name: Seven High Street shophouses
pierBuildingAudit.currentFoundation: seven solid stone y62..66 pads visually read as one blunt seawall
pierBuildingAudit.design: Keep varied shop fronts, apartments and stairs; replace visible waterside fill only with a regular pile grid, transverse caps, a continuous rear pier walk and short service bridges.

pierBuildingAudit.name: Ferry Bell House
pierBuildingAudit.design: Retain the bell room and street door; author an east-side ticket loggia, pile-supported waiting deck and a guarded gangway landing.

pierBuildingAudit.name: Beacon Inn
pierBuildingAudit.design: Keep the accepted six-floor inn and tower stair; articulate its south/west base as a stepped stone quay instead of opening the building foundation.

pierBuildingAudit.name: Skiff House
pierBuildingAudit.design: This is already the district's credible pile-building precedent; preserve it and extend its gangway language into the east secondary egress.

pierBuildingAudit.name: Field House, Lantern Hall and Gatehead House
pierBuildingAudit.design: Do not force a pier expression onto the stadium forecourt; maintain them as the landward civic threshold.

masterplanParcels.name: Westlight amusement pier planning envelope
masterplanParcels.deckRule: This rectangle is a zoning envelope, not a solid platform. Water slots remain open between pile-supported deck ribbons and buildings.

masterplanParcels.name: Protected stadium entrance throat
masterplanParcels.rule: Do not widen through the bowl fascia or fountain. Preserve the current four-block opening exactly.

masterplanParcels.name: Stadium-to-pier axial pedestrian mall
masterplanParcels.alignment: centered on the existing x=-354.5 stadium throat

masterplanParcels.name: Beacon-to-outer-pier independent west route
masterplanParcels.rule: Must remain independent of the primary axis through the full construction sequence.

masterplanParcels.name: Skiff-to-outer-pier independent east route
masterplanParcels.rule: Tie into the accepted Skiff gangway without severing its current approach.

masterplanParcels.name: Westlight shoreline roller coaster
masterplanParcels.rule: Track, support, queue and evacuation walk are one engineered object; no track may overfly a public mall without a protected soffit/clearance envelope.

masterplanParcels.name: Westlight observation wheel
masterplanParcels.rule: Preserve an unobstructed wheel clearance envelope, a separate maintenance enclosure and two paths from load platform to the cross mall.

masterplanParcels.name: Outer-end public quay and viewing terrace
masterplanParcels.rule: Maintain at least twelve clear blocks between restaurant walls and the seaward guard edge.

craterPlan.name: Westlight West Quarry Lagoon

quayEnvelope.note: Irregular ring only; never fill this full rectangle.

stadiumConnection.mode: graded overlook bridge and stair-free return route

craterPlan.releaseRule: The 12,288-cell figure is a measured design volume, not permission for a bulk SET. Every water and landscape change requires exact one-cell guards, cave/leak isolation, entity clearance, reversible vegetation handling and a post-fill shoreline/walk audit.

hardGates: No live mutation is authorized by this schedule.
A fresh immutable snapshot and database digest are mandatory before engineering.
Do not replay or erase the accepted stadium, theatre, screen, members club, room plans or vertical circulation.
The pier planning envelope must remain hydraulically open; never replace it with a solid stone rectangle.
Every over-water occupied building, ride and deck requires a pile/cap/load-path schedule and protected undercroft.
The coaster and wheel require ride-specific clearance, maintenance, control, queue and emergency-evacuation plans.
Maintain the primary, west and east pedestrian routes as independently walkable paths.
Use one-cell exact-state forward and rollback operations; no unmasked demolition or water SET boxes.
Run fluid-neighbor, waterlogged, gravity, block-entity, free-entity, player and cave-leak censuses before release.
Capture matched before/after maps and obliques, and require normal-walk QA in both directions for every public route.
